WHEREAS it is

regulation of civil aviation activities; to ensure civil aviation safety and
security; to give effect to the convention [s], treaties and agreements on
international civil aviation;

development, operations and maintenance of aerodromes, airports and related
infrastructure; and to control and regulate safe, secure, efficient, adequate,
economical and properly coordinated civil air transport service and air

ancillary thereto;

and the President of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan is satisfied that
circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now,
THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by clause (1) of
Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the
President of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan is pleased to make and promulgate
the following Ordinance:

GENERAL

Ordinance shall be called the Pakistan Civil Aviation Ordinance, 2021.
(2) It
extends to the whole of Pakistan.

all civil airports and aerodromes within
Pakistan;
(b)
all citizens of Pakistan and persons on any
aircraft registered or operated in Pakistan, wherever such citizen or aircraft
may be;

all persons on board any aircraft while in
Pakistan; and
(d)
all persons carrying on any activity relating to
or connected with the purposes of this Act:

Federal Government may, by notification in the official Gazette, direct that

force on such date as it may appoint in this behalf.

Civil Aviation Authority Fund. (1) There shall be a fund to be

pensions and other remuneration to the Director General, officers, servants,

prescribed conditions.

Civil Aviation Authority Fund shall be kept in any of the scheduled banks.

commencement of this Act, all investments along with its proceeds kept in any
